appearances.headline: Ling-3.2-air: open 124B multimodal MoE, 5.5B active
appearances.newly_possible: You can run an MIT-licensed multimodal MoE built for workflow automation and document reasoning that activates only 5.5B of 124B parameters per token.
appearances.why: Low active parameters with day-0 vLLM support and ready quants make agentic document workflows cheaper to self-host.
appearances.limits: AutomationBench-AA gain from 15.7% to 61% is the team's own figure.
